1003-4050-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
1003-4050-5006-8170.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, adding one mana of any color
Repeat.

240-1849-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-1849-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1077-3752-8193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Phage.
1077-3752-8193.description:
Donate control of Avacyn to an opponent using Wrong Turn.
Kill Phage by any method.
At the beginning of the next end step, Avacyn triggers, returning Phage from your graveyard to the battlefield under the opponent's control.
When Phage enters, its first ability triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

3781-4215-4247--124.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
3781-4215-4247--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.

1981-2415-2999-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2999-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-2999-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

7009-7638-7803.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
7009-7638-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
7009-7638-7803.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mind Stone triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Brad Boimler.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1621-2146-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-4772-6627.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season and The Earth Crystal.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-3480.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1824-2530-3497-7350.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-3497-7350.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
1824-2530-3497-7350.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Demon's Horn triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

2919-4050-5086-5183-6441.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4050-5086-5183-6441.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

414-713-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
414-713-4613.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
When the Insect enters, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Insect. This causes it to gain Grist's abilities due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

2203-2366-4785-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2203-2366-4785-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
392-3532-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}..
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

1495-1887-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Vorinclex.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2364-3767-3918-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Mana Vault's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

4616-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
4616-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

1444-5195-6259.description:
Cast Elvish Fury with buyback by paying {G}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Elvish Fury.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2541-5010-5646.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2541-5010-5646.description:
Attempt to draw card, instead choosing to mill 4 cards and return Golgari Thug from your graveyard to your hand.
If you milled a nonland card, The Wise Mothman triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to draw a card and discard Golgari Thug.
Repeat.
2541-5010-5646.notes: The combo fails if you do not mill a nonland card.

2034-2178-3484-4023-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Dr Madison Li does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Dr Madison Li.
You have at least five energy counters.
2034-2178-3484-4023-4840.description:
Activate Dr Madison Li's third ability by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlepshere enters the battlefield, it and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers four times.
Resolve all Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Battlesphere dies, Dr Madison Li triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

1908-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1908-3259.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

729-732-3113.notablePrerequisites:
Fire Whip attached to Felhide Spiritbender.
Felhide Spiritbender does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
729-732-3113.description:
Activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Felhide Spiritbender triggers, holding priority, activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Resolve the Felhide Spiritbender trigger, causing you to pay {1}{R} to create a token copy of Great Oak Guardian with haste.
The token Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Felhide Spiritbinder by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Great Oak Guardian trigger, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 5.

2440-3089-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
The four Myr tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes four times.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least 25 {C}.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing a Myr token, returning Myr Battlesphere from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2382-3492-3609.description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Coretapper with haste that will be exiled at the beginning of the next end step.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of the end step, the delayed ability from Mimic Vat triggers, failing to exile anything.
Repeat each turn.
